register_patch_mapping: register a mapping of original class names or regex patterns to replacement nn.Module classes for automatic model patching
unregister_patch_mapping: unregister patch mappings by key to disable automatic class replacement during model loading
apply_patches: apply registered monkey patches within a context manager to temporarily replace classes during model construction
patch_output_recorders: patch output recorders in a model's submodules to use registered replacement classes
get_patch_mapping: get all registered patch mappings as a dictionary from class names or patterns to replacement classes
